question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Prompt
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Delayed'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** 'Prompt' **generally refers to something done quickly and without delay, or exactly at the appointed time. Its Hindi meaning is 'शीघ्र' or 'तत्पर'.

 
 
• **Example: **She was always prompt in her response to any requests.
 
 
 
• The antonym** 'Delayed' **signifies something delayed or put off till a later time. Its Hindi meaning is 'विलंबित' or 'देरी हुई'.
 
 
• **Example: **Due to the storm, all flights were delayed.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is **'Delayed'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Attentive'** as per Option 1 means paying close attention to something.(सावधान)
 
• **'Initiate'** as per Option 2 typically means causing a process or action to begin.(आरंभ करना).
 
• **'Efficient' **as per Option 4 means working in a well-organized and competent way, achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense.(सक्षम).
